googlePlay.title: vCGE: Business Card to Contact
googlePlay.shortDescription: Snap a business card, get a phone contact. Read on your phone, no internet.
googlePlay.fullDescription:
Operation: Never Lose Contact

Someone hands you a business card. You mean to save it, and then it sits in a pocket for a month. vCGE fixes that in under a minute: take a photo of the card and get a finished phone contact.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap the card, or pick a photo you already took.
• vCGE reads it on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
• Check the fields: name, title, company, phones, emails, website and address.
• Save it to your contacts, or share it as a .vcf file, a QR code, an email or a text.
• Print or save a PDF of the card with its QR code beside it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No internet. The app does not even ask for the internet permission.
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Nothing is stored. The card lives in memory and is wiped when you leave, or after a few idle minutes.
• Lock a card with a session PIN while you step away.
• The only thing kept is your settings, on your phone.

MADE TO BE EASY TO READ
• Light and dark themes, four text sizes and seven fonts, including Atkinson Hyperlegible and OpenDyslexic.
• Color-blind modes and a left- or right-hand layout.
• A 3D card you can flip and spin, with its QR code on the back.

OPEN SOURCE
vCGE is open source. The store price supports the people building it. Source code: github.com/real-raven575/vCGE-Master

WHO MADE IT
vCGE is made by raven575 with help from AI coding assistants: the Herd of Helpers, a team of Claude projects that each look after one part of the app, plus earlier work in individual Gemini sessions. raven575 leads the project and decides what goes in.

• Light and dark themes, four text sizes, seven fonts including Atkinson Hyperlegible and OpenDyslexic, and color-blind modes.
